Preventive Health Screening Standards
Routine health screenings help detect potential health issues before
symptoms appear. Recommended Adult Screenings: - Annual blood pressure
check for adults aged 18 and older. - Regular cholesterol and blood
glucose evaluations as recommended by your primary care provider.
